summary: Misapplied advance payment posted to a closed PO; vendor balance showing in suspense
summary_long: An advance payment from Vendor: HelioMetrics was automatically applied by the AR/AP sync to a PO that was previously closed. The vendor account now shows a small credit in the suspense account and the intended refund / credit note has not been issued.
impact: Vendor balance inaccurate; potential duplicate credit to wrong cost center when finance closes month-end. Affects one active vendor (HelioMetrics) and one past PO. Accounting needs a clean AP ledger before month-end close (3 business days).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Review AP ledger for vendor HelioMetrics (vendor id VM-8821)
3) Identify payment 2026-03-03 (ACH TXN 0x7f4a) which was a supplier-initiated refund/credit
4) Observe that the payment was allocated to PO-2024012 (status = Closed) rather than to vendor-credit account/suspense as expected
expected_behavior: Refund/credit from vendor should land in vendor suspense account or create a credit memo, not be applied to closed PO lines. Allocation rules should ignore closed POs for auto-apply logic.
actual_behavior: Payment auto-applied to closed PO-2024012 which has status 'Closed - Received'. The PO's cost center was archived and the posting routed to a legacy GL code, causing the amount to land in Suspense:AP:Legacy instead of VendorCredit.
logs: AP sync job id: sync-2026-03-03-22:14 UTC
Payment record: {tx_id: 0x7f4a, vendor: VM-8821, amount: 1,240.00, currency: USD}
Journal entry created: JE-2026-03-03-4821 -> posted to GL Suspense:AP:Legacy
investigation_notes: (2026-03-10) Initial triage by finance-helpdesk: found payment was processed by automated AP allocation service 'ap-allocator'.
(2026-03-10) Checked mapping history: ap_alloc_v2 introduced a change on 2026-02-28 that relaxed PO status checks when matching incoming remittances.

(2026-03-11) Ran SQL to validate matching behavior: SELECT * FROM ap_allocations WHERE payment_tx='0x7f4a' -> allocator matched to po_id 'PO-2024012' because PO line still had a residual_receipt_flag = true despite status = 'Closed'.

(2026-03-11) Hypothesis: residual_receipt_flag was left true during a partial return flow in Nov 2025; ap_alloc_v2 no longer filters by that flag, causing closed POs with residual=true to be considered match candidates.
(2026-03-11) Cross-checked with procurement: PO-2024012 was closed after GRN but retained a manual legacy flag for 'legacy-receipts' for audit reasons.

(2026-03-12) Confirmed config: ap-allocator strategy priority list used order [po_match -> invoice_match -> vendor_suspense] and will prefer PO match even if PO.status in (Closed) when residual_receipt_flag = true (new logic).
comments: Amina Chaudhry (Finance Helpdesk) - 2026-03-10: Logged ticket after vendor reported incorrect balance. Added initial payment details and flagged month-end risk.
Jacob Liu (AP Systems) - 2026-03-10: Assigned for investigation. Noted ap-allocator recent deploy. Will reproduce in staging.
Sofia Patel (Procurement) - 2026-03-11: Confirmed PO-2024012 was intentionally left with residual_receipt_flag for audit trail. Procurement happy for finance to reallocate if needed.

Jacob Liu - 2026-03-11: Reproduced in staging by replaying payment event; ap-allocator matched closed PO when residual_receipt_flag=true. Creating a fix candidate to ignore closed PO statuses for auto-apply.
Michael Torres (Controller) - 2026-03-12: Agrees to manual journal adjustment to correct vendor balance now; asks for test plan before deploy to prod.
Jacob Liu - 2026-03-12: Pushed hotfix branch 'ap-allocator-ignore-closed-po' -> PR ready. Will schedule patch outside cutover window and run QA with finance team.
Amina Chaudhry - 2026-03-12: Raised request to notify vendor HelioMetrics of expected credit memo/refund timeline.
resolution_notes: (Workaround) 2026-03-12: Finance performed manual reversal journal JE-2026-03-12-4902 to move $1,240.00 from Suspense:AP:Legacy back to VendorCredit:VM-8821 and issued a vendor credit note VC-2026-03-12-77.

(Code fix) 2026-03-12: AP systems team prepared PR to change ap-allocator behavior: ignore PO matches when PO.status IN ('Closed', 'Cancelled') unless explicit override is present. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ap-allocator/pull/312
(Testing) 2026-03-12: QA ran regression cases (including legacy residual_receipt_flag scenarios) in staging and confirmed fix prevents auto-apply to closed POs and routes to vendor suspense.

(Deployment) 2026-03-13 planned: hotfix scheduled during low-traffic window 02:00-03:00 UTC; on-call notified. Post-deploy checks documented in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/820123/PO+auto-apply+runbook
(Follow-up) Create a small audit job to scan for similar misapplied payments in last 6 months and open follow-up tickets for each hit. Owner: Jacob Liu. Target: 2026-03-20.
(Preventive) Add test-case in CI for residual_receipt_flag + closed PO combination and update ap-allocator config docs. Owner: SRE/Test infra.
next_steps: 1) Deploy hotfix to production and monitor AP allocation queue for 24 hours
2) Run audit job for past 6 months to identify similar allocations and remediate manually
3) Update AP allocation runbook and add CI test to prevent regressions
4) Finance to confirm vendor communications and close ticket once post-deploy checks pass
